plugins.name: plugin-flutter
plugins.description: Flutter/Dart project workflows: bootstrap, TDD features, Git hygiene, session recovery, GitHub pull requests and CI, debugging.

plugins.name: plugin-nixos
plugins.description: Gérer la configuration NixOS d'un poste depuis Claude Code : la trouver ou la reprendre de /etc/nixos dans un dépôt git, prouver une option avant de l'écrire, vérifier sans privilège, et s'arrêter sur la commande à lancer soi-même. Un garde refuse d'activer, d'installer impérativement et de détruire des générations.

plugins.name: plugin-plugin
plugins.description: Frame, scaffold, test and publish Claude Code plugins to a documented model of its own: TDD components, evals, release, re-audit.

plugins.name: plugin-orchestrator
plugins.description: Drives a software project from zero to delivery through project-level documents, shared Git, GitHub, TDD, recovery and debugging workflows, and multi-part coordination, delegating all language-specific work to the specialized plugins.

plugins.name: plugin-motion
plugins.description: Make Remotion motion-design videos storyboard-first: set up a checked video project, storyboard a brief, build each scene in a render-and-review loop, sync animations to a voiceover, and render a final MP4 verified against the storyboard.
